Supports standard households paying 90% of each current price per hour on NOK 0.77/ kWh before VAT, for qualifying usage up to 5,000 kWh per month. Norgespris uses a fixed reference price of NOK 0.50/ kWh including VAT (NOK 0.40 without VAT on electricity); its payment uses the current monthly average area price and uses qualifying metering. The limit is 5,000 kWh/ month for homes or 1,000 kWh/ month for guesthouses. A household can choose one plan, not both. Network and other charges are entered separately and added to all scenarios. The comparison uses the exact time data you provide; it does not take prices.
